title: blephariglottis pallida
intro: Blephariglottis pallida, commonly known as Indian yellow gentian, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family, which is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Blephariglottis pallida include adaptogenic and anxiolytic effects, which may help to alleviate anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, such as gentiopicroside and swertiamarin, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
